faq.q: What is an AI TikTok ads generator?
faq.a: It turns a product photo or a product link into a vertical TikTok ad. You can use an [AI actor](/ai-video-generation/ai-actors), a script, and a voice, then edit any of them.

faq.q: How does a product link become a TikTok video?
faq.a: Paste the product page link. The draft picks up the product name and pictures, and the editor can write a first script. You pick the actor and you can rewrite any line. You can also upload a photo instead.

faq.q: How quickly can I get a TikTok file?
faq.a: We do not promise a clock time. You add a link or a photo, pick the actor and the voice, and download. For the opening, walk through [how to make a TikTok ad](/guides/first-tiktok-video-ad).

faq.q: Can I customize the script, actor, and voice?
faq.a: Yes. Rewrite the script, swap the actor, change the voice, and add captions or music in the editor before you publish.

faq.q: What does a TikTok clip cost?
faq.a: A clip costs 24, 40, 60 or 120 credits for 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds. The price shows before you start. If a file fails, those credits return on their own. There is no free plan.

faq.q: Will this choose my TikTok audience?
faq.a: No. You make versions with different scripts, actors, and tones. Targeting and budget stay in TikTok Ads Manager. Check TikTok's current rules for AI content on the day you publish.

faq.q: Can I publish to TikTok from here?
faq.a: Yes. Download the file with no watermark, or send it to TikTok from the editor. You still set the audience and the budget in Ads Manager.

faq.q: Can I make a batch of versions?
faq.a: Yes. Make another file with a different action, language, or line. Each file shows its own credit cost first.

faq.q: Can an AI TikTok ad beat a filmed ad?
faq.a: We do not promise a higher result than a filmed ad. You can test more openings from the same product without booking another shoot.
